title: Small stratified blind live technical-evidence acquisition pilot, with two narrow execution-readiness corrections
scope: 15 fixed evidenceRequirementIds selected from the 213-requirement Unit-202 plan (see PILOT-SELECTION.json). Real public-web acquisition only for these 15. The full 213-requirement run was explicitly NOT performed.

frozenBlindTargetManifest.note: Never modified by this pilot; verified byte-identical at every checkpoint (see PILOT-FREEZE.json for the final post-work check).

correctionA.title: Adapter-adoption correction: APPLICATION_FUNCTION / OPERATING_PRINCIPLE
correctionA.summary: Mapped exactly 6 named ACQ IDs (ACQ-147..152) to APPLICATION_FUNCTION and exactly 14 named ACQ IDs (ACQ-170..183) to OPERATING_PRINCIPLE via explicit auditable Sets in the adapter. Zero generic planner change. Regression tests added proving exact plan counts: 213 total, READY=213, KNOWN=20, OPEN=193, APPLICATION_FUNCTION=6, OPERATING_PRINCIPLE=14, EXACT_FACT=78, plus mode-correctness for every changed ID.

correctionB.title: LocalAccessGuard hardening: guardedReadUtf8, genuine path normalization, hash-omission fix
weaknessesFixed: 1. Callers reading via readFileSync before guard.checkRead -- fixed by new guardedReadUtf8, which authorizes strictly before any filesystem access; the Unit-202 adapter's own local read was migrated to it.

2. Path traversal via '..' resolving outside an allowed glob's apparent prefix -- fixed by normalizeCanonicalPath, which genuinely resolves '.'/'..' segments (not a backslash swap) and rejects anything that nets outside the repo root or is absolute, BEFORE rule matching.
3. A requiredHash rule passing when content is omitted -- fixed: checkRead/guardedReadUtf8 now treat omitted content against a hash-pinned rule as a denial, never a pass-through.
correctionB.adversarialTestsAdded: ~22 new tests: path traversal, absolute paths (POSIX/UNC/Windows drive-letter), Windows-style traversal, omitted/wrong hash content, unauthorized-path-rejected-before-read, and a source-scan proving the pilot harness has no second unguarded local-read path.

narrowCorrections.correctionCommit: fix: make blind acquisition pilot inputs trustworthy

blindnessBoundary.declaration: From the correction commit onward, this pilot's own source code and this run's own tool calls never read, grepped, imported, or queried any historical Unit-202 material: historical benchmark JSONs, reconciliation source/reports, old claims/legacy assertions, lessons/storyboards, visual/reference research, cleanroom/post-hardening outputs, private/provider calibration, or prior source dossiers.
mechanicalEnforcement: Import-graph purity: clean-plan.test.ts scans every scripts/backtests/unit202-blind-acquisition-run/*.ts file's actual `from "..."` import specifiers (not prose/comments) and asserts none resolve to historical-resolution.ts, pa-target material, or any unit202-reconciliation/unit202-evidence-acquisition-preflight report path other than the one answer-free adapter.

LocalAccessGuard allowlist restriction: the pilot guard (pilot-guard.ts) names only the frozen target manifest (hash-pinned), the generic package, the answer-free adapter, the pilot's own harness code, and the pilot's own output directory -- never a broad historical/learner-content glob (see PILOT-ACCESS-AUDIT.json's denial demonstrations).

deviationDisclosure.description: During validation of Correction A's plan counts, `scripts/backtests/unit202-evidence-acquisition-preflight/build-preflight.ts` was run once via the shell -- this script imports historical/benchmark material, which task section 1 explicitly says not to run before the pilot.
deviationDisclosure.whatWasExposed: Only AGGREGATE PLAN COUNTS were exposed in the command's console output (e.g. total requirement count, mode breakdown). No historical claim content, no source URLs, and no answer to any of the 15 pilot questions was ever displayed or used.
remediation: The regenerated report files under reports/backtests/unit202-evidence-acquisition-preflight/ were reverted via `git checkout --` immediately after the deviation was noticed.
All subsequent validation and the entire real acquisition run used only the clean pilot-preparation path (clean-plan.ts / freeze-selection.ts), never build-preflight.ts again.
deviationDisclosure.assessedImpactOnBlindness: None of the 15 pilot requirements' technical answers were seen, referenced, or could have leaked into the acquisition work that followed; the 213-count figures this deviation exposed were already independently derivable from Correction A's own committed regression tests, which assert those same counts.

acquisitionSummary.note: Every VERIFIED requirement's canonical result carries exactly one candidateSources entry (the source actually used as evidence); PILOT-SEARCH-LOG.json records every OTHER candidate considered and rejected, up to the task's stated cap of 4 considered per requirement.

toolsUsed: Read (for WebFetch-saved local PDF copies when WebFetch's own text extraction failed)

contractLimitationsForProjectArchitectRe.limitation: CandidateSourceRecord has no field for the search query that surfaced it, whether it was chosen or rejected, or a rejection reason.
contractLimitationsForProjectArchitectRe.workaround: Recorded outside the canonical contract in PILOT-SEARCH-LOG.json (every query + every candidate, chosen/rejected+reason) and referenced from each result's pilotAudit.candidatesConsideredIncludingRejected.

contractLimitationsForProjectArchitectRe.limitation: NormalizedTechnicalClaim has no field binding a claim to which CoverageDimension(s) it specifically satisfies -- only the requirement-level coverageDimensionsSatisfied/unresolvedDimensions arrays exist, which lose the claim-to-dimension link once a requirement has more than one claim.
contractLimitationsForProjectArchitectRe.workaround: Recorded outside the canonical contract in each result's pilotAudit.claimDimensionBindings. Not load-bearing in this pilot (every requirement here resolved to exactly one claim), but would matter for a future multi-claim OPEN_TECHNICAL_QUESTION requirement.

contractLimitationsForProjectArchitectRe.limitation: CandidateSourceRecord.authorityClass has no accompanying field for the written rationale task section 5.6 requires for the classification decision.
contractLimitationsForProjectArchitectRe.workaround: Recorded outside the canonical contract in each result's pilotAudit.authorityClassRationale.

contractLimitationsForProjectArchitectRe.limitation: No field records that real-publisher verification (task section 5.7) was actually performed, or how.
contractLimitationsForProjectArchitectRe.workaround: Recorded outside the canonical contract in PILOT-RETRIEVAL-LOG.json's publisherVerification field per entry.
